title: KOM'S Sea Tweaks
description: KOM'S Sea Tweaks changes a few blocks and items in attempt to make them look better, but fit the vanilla style!
body:
# KOM'S Sea Tweaks

Wanted to find a pack to change basic textures, but keeps them vanilla? Maybe you found frogspawn block too disgusting to look at? Or maybe you noticed how outdated lily pad looks? This pack is for you!

## List Of Changes:
- Frogspawn
- Dried Kelp Block
- Lily Pad
- Prismarine Crystals
